name: John Marshall Bancorp, Inc.
summary: John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for John Marshall Bank that provides banking products and financial services in Arlington, Fairfax, Loudoun, Prince William, Montgomery, District of Columbia. The company offers checking, NOW, money market accounts, and savings accounts; certificates of deposit; and time, reciprocal IntraFi Demand, IntraFi Money Market, and IntraFi CD deposits.
